title: OpenEvidence, which is building "ChatGPT for doctors", raised $250M led by Thrive and DST at a $12B valuation, up from $6B in October and $1B in February 2025 (Kate Rooney/CNBC)
summary: Kate Rooney / CNBC: OpenEvidence, which is building “ChatGPT for doctors”, raised $250M led by Thrive and DST at a $12B valuation, up from $6B in October and $1B in February 2025 — A startup widely known as “ChatGPT for doctors” raised a new funding round that values the company at $12 billion.
contentText:
Kate Rooney / CNBC :

OpenEvidence, which is building “ChatGPT for doctors”, raised $250M led by Thrive and DST at a $12B valuation, up from $6B in October and $1B in February 2025   —  A startup widely known as “ChatGPT for doctors” raised a new funding round that values the company at $12 billion.
